_comment: NitroFusion2 GGUF (1 step) - Text to Image. Export (API) format for a bitGen Studio image style.
2.729.0 (Tim: "can u add this please https://chendaryen.github.io/NitroFusion2.github.io/"). NitroFusion2 (Dar-Yen Chen, Yi-Zhe Song,
Apache-2.0) is Z-Image-Turbo distilled to 1-2 steps with an adversarial loss on the MMDiT's text stream - sharp text and fine detail in one step.
Derived from the authors' own ComfyUI workflow (github.com/ChenDarYen/NitroFusion2: workflows/nitrofusion2_1step.json): node types, widget
Flattened from workflows/nitrofusion2_1step_gguf.json, with ComfyUI's own CLIPLoader for the text encoder (the same qwen_3_4b
the other NitroFusion2 styles use - one download) and ComfyUI-GGUF's UnetLoaderGGUF for the model (Settings ▸ ComfyUI installs ComfyUI-GGUF).
MODELS: models/unet/nf2-Q4_K_M.gguf (5.1 GB - any of ChenDY/NitroFusion2's GGUF tiers, Q2_K_4XS 2.0 GB to Q8_0 7.2 GB: set the style's Model),
models/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors, models/vae/ae.safetensors. 1 step, cfg 1, euler / simple, shift 3, 1024 x 1024.
